post.description:
Uploads the media HEADER file and returns the `header_handle` Meta requires.

Meta does not accept the file directly when creating the template: it requires the handle from the Resumable Upload API, which depends on the application token. This endpoint bridges that.

file.description: Header file (image, video or document). 100 MB limit

400.description: Invalid request — empty file or missing `type`

422.description: The account has no Meta App ID and App Secret configured (`MISSING_APP_CREDENTIALS`)

502.description: Meta refused the upload (`META_REFUSED`) or the app configuration could not be read (`CONFIG_UNREACHABLE`)

get.description: Returns the ready-made templates from Meta's library, which can be created without going through review.

MetaError.description: Error returned by Meta when processing the request.

errors.name: META_WHATSAPP_ERROR
errors.message: Your message could not be sent because it contains content that other people on Facebook have reported as abusive.

errors.name: META_WHATSAPP_ERROR
errors.description: There is already English (US) content for this template. You can create a new template and try again.

name.description: Template name: lowercase letters, digits and underscore. It cannot be changed after creation.

category.description: Several types have a fixed category. See "Template types".

language.description: Language in Meta's format, such as pt_BR or en_US.

parameter_format.description: Variable syntax. Named is Meta's current format.

message_send_ttl_seconds.description: Delivery window in seconds. Range by category: authentication 30 to 900, marketing 43200 to 2592000, utility 30 to 43200. The value -1 is a shortcut for 30 days.

allow_category_change.description: Lets Meta recategorize the template during review.

library_template_name.description: Model name in Meta's template library. See "Template Library".

library_template_body_inputs.description: Body options the library model accepts.

library_template_button_inputs.description: Button data for the library model.

components.description: Template components. What fits here depends on the type: see "Template types" and "Validation".

synced.description: Indicates whether the synchronization was successful

success.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful

h.description: Handle to use as the HEADER component `example` when creating the template

TemplateVariableExample.description: An example for each variable, in the order they appear. Meta rejects the template without it.

header_handle.description: Media handle, obtained in "Upload media", or the public file link.

text.description: Header text. Accepts at most one variable.
Message text. Accepts line breaks and variables.
Footer text. Variables are not accepted.

code_expiration_minutes.description: Code validity, from 1 to 90 minutes. Authentication templates only.

buttons.description: Quick replies first, then the rest: Meta rejects the template when the order mixes the two groups.

cards.description: Carousel cards. All of them must have the same components.

limited_time_offer.description: Offer badge. The deadline itself goes in the send, not in the creation.

text.description: Button text. On fixed-label types, Meta overwrites whatever is sent.
Button text. On fixed-label types, Meta overwrites whatever is sent.

url.description: Accepts one variable, and only at the end of the URL.

phone_number.description: International format, with the country code.

example.description: Sample code Meta uses during review. Letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.

otp_type.description: How the customer gets the code. ONE_TAP and ZERO_TAP require the app details.
